LegacyPracticeRef5.description: Mode/script-specific task plus the canonical basic-question version. Server verifies article/snapshot/bundle/script/task/question mappings; caller IDs grant no authority.

ProfileContext.description: Server-derived owner and deletion generation. Incoming values are expected context only; JWT subject + active session binding authorize the request.

ResumeRef.description: listening references an unfinished checkpoint; practice references an unfinished lesson OR a completed lesson with pending_feedback_attempt_id. Reading a result is not a presentation ACK. Completion/ACK clears only a pointer still targeting that lesson.

CommonProfileContext.description: Server-derived owner and deletion generation. Incoming values are expected context only; JWT subject + active session binding authorize the request.

CommonClientContext.description: Owner/epoch are checked against the verified session and stored operation; revision/token only control presentation. They cannot grant access.

CommonSettings.description: Default original_full is not an explicit choice. Followup is null until selected; none is an explicit no-followup choice. Completed onboarding requires non-null followup. Merge chooses each explicitly chosen current-vehicle field, otherwise the target account field.

CommonCapture.description: Capture claims are data, not authorization. Server-configured verified path/version or explicit confirmation must support any form correction; unknown forbids form correction. spoken_language describes original speech, not answer_text. Validate configured route/version or one original-capture/lesson/owner-bound specific confirmation before acceptance. Generic yes/new text cannot overwrite known Korean evidence. Mixed names/quotes are allowed only when the core English answer is verified. If uncertainty remains after one confirmation, suspend/no valid English turn. Unknown form alone does not block verified-English content judgement. Claims never authorize storage/output.

CommonLessonState.description: Server-owned state; model output/client flags never set anchors or terminal state directly. Unassessable uses no valid turn. Completed may still have pending feedback delivery and is then resumable. Retry refusal preserves the first validated content_success (including sufficient content with language_form correction); refusal awards no new success. Without a retry, retry_outcome is null, meaning not assessed. Assign valid first/retry/content_success only after server-verified English eligibility and assessable recognition. Non-English/unverified holds do not create or replace anchors, completion or first success; preserve a prior valid first on a held retry.

CommonBasicQuestionRef.description: Immutable canonical identity for question meaning, required facts and judgement criteria. Publisher reuses it across equal-semantic mode/task/audio/bundle variants; server validates task mapping. Changing example wording alone never resets this identity.

CommonHistoryCoverage.description: Minimal profile-level provenance, not a retained per-question deletion list. New empty history after deletion or legacy gaps does not prove no prior example exposure.

CommonQuestionExampleExposure.description: Read-only current projection per profile/current epoch/article/canonical question. Exposed dominates uncertainty; verified absence requires complete retained history and no unresolved earlier presentation. Missing rows never imply verified absence.

CommonExampleExposureAssessment.description: Server-derived assessment at a causal boundary, independent of answer payload and current lesson help. Created before model execution under the exposure lock. Unknown cannot be upgraded to verified absence by a late empty ACK; stronger earlier exposure proof may revise unknown to exposed. Future presentations do not reclassify a proven earlier answer.

CommonSupportArtifact.description: Prepared, immutable reviewed output component. Not evidence of received help. Exact text/hash is bound to the question/task; full examples cannot be hidden in untracked generic feedback. Role/language are explicit and do not come from ref suffixes/text detection. kind is a metric HelpKind, nullable only for question_meaning; null still records actual help/ref/role and never means no help. Default question_meaning/core_explanation is ko; an explicit response-language change uses an approved matching artifact, never silent replacement.

CommonEnglishAttemptStatus.description: Read-only server-derived eligibility from validated original-language evidence, independent of content judgement and form fidelity. English-looking normalized text is not proof.

CommonPracticeSupportManifest.description: Published exact role/language/ref/text/hash map. Require five reviewed defaults for every task; optional approved language variants fit the same immutable question. Partial correction may be private feedback instead of a publication default. Check unique support_ref and main fact coverage server-side.

CommonDialogueProgress.description: Durable business flag per owner/epoch/lesson, initially false. Only actual verified HINT_METHOD output completion journals true. Server OR-merges within a lesson; false never resets existing true. New lesson resets; same lesson retry/resume/another device preserves. No elapsed timer, live lease/output token or safety grant is stored here.

PersonalResumeRef.description: listening references an unfinished checkpoint; practice references an unfinished lesson OR a completed lesson with pending_feedback_attempt_id. Reading a result is not a presentation ACK. Completion/ACK clears only a pointer still targeting that lesson.

resume_version.description: Independent optimistic version for active_resume. History deletion, merge or completion clearing the pointer advances this version.

profile_kind.description: Derived from verified identity/ownership, never speaker identity or user_metadata. One active app profile; no automatic OS profile link.

PersonalBootstrapRequest.description: Creates/resolves one server owner for the verified auth subject. An arbitrary pre-existing provisional UUID never grants access; return an authorized mapping for local first-use records only.

PersonalSettingsPatch.description: Only keys under set are explicit choices; server updates explicit_fields. Untouched initial defaults do not override target settings at merge. Omitted keys remain unchanged. Learning-history epoch changes do not reject a same-owner preference patch; expected settings version still applies. The response reports the current history epoch.

PersonalCheckpointInput.description: Pinned selection ownership/content refs must match. Main/followup asset/duration match server metadata and position<=duration; article_offer has null asset/duration and position0. Caller cannot declare completion.

PersonalLessonInput.description: Client may request only valid transitions. Completion, judgement and validated feedback are server-owned; phase feedback_pending/retry_offer must match stored attempts/results. Never accepts prior exposure/status/assessment. Help arrays describe observed current-lesson support, not generated candidates; server validates against delivery evidence. Persist/restore dialogue business progress separately from live timers. New lesson false; existing same lesson uses monotonic OR, validated at current owner/epoch. Explicit record version conflicts do not erase true.

PersonalAttemptInput.description: First has null previous ID; retry references same-owner same-task feedback. New recording uses new UUID. An unassessable recording does not spend a valid turn. Flush witnessed support receipts before acceptance; the server derives exposure at this boundary and unions confirmed support separately. Missing help arrays never prove unexposed. Offline/legacy uncertain exposure remains unknown. Original-language evidence is checked independently from form. Server derives English eligibility; a normalized English string cannot consume a valid turn. Prefer resolving one language confirmation before immutable AttemptAccepted; unresolved API input follows the unassessable branch.

PersonalCheckpointEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

PersonalLessonEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

PersonalAttemptEvent.description: Null expected version is conditional create only; non-null is optimistic update. Immutable attempt content cannot be changed by update.

PersonalSyncRequest.description: UTF-8 request <=256 KiB; split by both count and bytes. Validate all events before atomic batch commit. Stale epoch rejects the entire batch; no implicit adoption of the current epoch.

PersonalLessonRecord.description: Read-only authoritative lesson state, anchors, end reason and undelivered feedback. New explicit practice has a new lesson UUID. prior_example_exposure is the server lesson_start assessment; new lessons reset valid turns, never the canonical exposure history. help_received/support_refs are validated current-lesson reports; pending/generated support is separate. Persist/restore dialogue business progress separately from live timers. New lesson false; existing same lesson uses monotonic OR, validated at current owner/epoch. Explicit record version conflicts do not erase true.

PersonalSyncPage.description: If client epoch is stale: reset_required true, records empty, cursor null. Client discards old local history/outbox before requesting the new generation. Never expose data from a different owner.

PersonalMergePrepare.description: Anonymous source only. Flush source learning/deletion outbox and confirm ACK before prepare; source cursor must cover local immutable submissions. Server derives source, never accepts arbitrary source owner IDs.

PersonalMergeIntent.description: One-use source proof, default lifetime 300 seconds. Keep proof and source session reference in protected flow journal until success/rollback; never log them. Expiry preserves both profiles and requires a fresh prepared proof.

PersonalMergeComplete.description: Verified permanent target plus source proof. Recheck source/target epochs and source sync watermark in one transaction. Existing signed-in A-to-B switches are not merges.

PersonalMergeReceipt.description: Same target can retry the same completion. Keep target privacy_epoch stable; merge is not deletion. Source owner retirement blocks its old JWTs. Source explicit settings/ongoing resume win; absent values fall back; distinct history remains. Cancel old-owner inflight processing and resume migrated attempts under target authorization. Transfer the source explicit unfinished or undelivered-result active_resume pointer, not the record with the newest timestamp; otherwise preserve the target pointer. Advance target resume_version in the merge transaction. Move stream/selection/run/observation/completion/lesson state and pending presentation, preserving real repeats; do not union independent runs. Source current pending-result resume may win.

PersonalDeletionRequest.description: Resolve an already committed operation receipt before stale-epoch rejection. For a new operation require the current history epoch. Replaying a receipt never decreases the client current epoch; fetch current profile context before any history upload.

PersonalDeletionReceipt.description: Epoch increments once per operation; delete history/attempts/feedback/progress/queues and invalidate operations. Keep auth/settings and minimal receipt metadata. Offline devices apply on next authorized profile sync; already-offline devices are not claimed erased immediately. Clear active_resume and advance resume_version in the deletion transaction. Delete all new coverage/completion/selection/terminal/presentation learning records; old generation cannot recreate them.

PersonalLogoutRequest.description: Must equal verified JWT session_id for this installation. Use isolated captured old session context; never send the new anonymous bearer to revoke the previous session. Repeated receipt lookup is allowed only for the same verified subject/session/key even after own binding retirement. History epoch staleness does not prevent closing the same verified session; this endpoint accepts no history write. Same subject/session can retry only the existing logout receipt.

PersonalLogoutReceipt.description: Retires only the app binding of this session. SDK provider signOut(LOCAL) and local clearing are separate effects; do not claim global provider revocation. Offline client journal blocks old-owner UI/sync immediately and retries on the isolated prior context.

PersonalAudioAccessResponse.description: HTTPS outside explicit loopback development. URL expiry is not a content version; new range/seek renewal uses a fresh operation_id and revalidates rights. No immediate revocation of already issued bytes is claimed.

PersonalResumeSelection.description: Explicit resume selection after the referenced record has been acknowledged by sync. Verify owner, current history epoch and expected_resume_version atomically; null clears the pointer. Same operation/payload returns the original receipt before version checking; different payload conflicts. A stale receipt cannot lower locally observed epoch/version. A version conflict preserves all history and the current local task, and does not blindly overwrite a newer selection. Background outbox replay must not infer or select a target from timestamps. Mark explicit start/resume/practice or the active queue next transition locally, flush its referenced records, then send this operation. Deletion/merge/logout boundaries invalidate unsent previous-context selection intents.

PersonalStreamInput.description: Create stream metadata only. No future item array, total count, duration or product item limit. Mutations of the current head are server-owned.

PersonalStreamEvent.description: Conditional metadata create only; existing same ID/hash is duplicate, conflicting payload is conflict.

PersonalStreamRecord.description: Actual selected history only. Read wrapper version is the optimistic head version.

PersonalCheckpointRecord.description: Pinned selection ownership/content refs must match. Main/followup asset/duration match server metadata and position<=duration; article_offer has null asset/duration and position0. Caller cannot declare completion.

PersonalSelectionRecord.description: Immutable one-article selection. Current article refs/settings stay pinned; next selection re-queries live eligible catalog. Ordinal is not an index into a preallocated item array. settings_snapshot is the saved preference snapshot pinned at the original selection, not an overwritten effective mode. On explicit_format_change, content_ref carries the one-time mode and format_change_source anchors saved work; copy the source followup policy. previous_selection_id is the actual stream head, not necessarily the source selection. Never update ProfileSettings.

PersonalPlaybackObservationEvent.description: Immutable conditional create; duplicate UUID/hash returns original receipt, different payload conflicts.

PersonalNextArticleRequest.description: Create StreamInput through sync first. Select only at a real article boundary/explicit request, not speculative prefetch. Atomically lock profile epoch + stream head; one next per expected head. Return same persisted receipt for the same operation; different simultaneous head requests conflict. Current topics OR, catalog published_at DESC/article_id tie; automatic excludes completed and already visited articles in this stream. Explicit replay requires explicit user intent. Check latest access again at playback.

PersonalNextArticleResponse.description: Selected creates one selection + initial checkpoint atomically. Client stores receipt then selects resume via the versioned resume API. A stale result never instructs current playback or lowers local epoch/version. No-candidate is not a network error or blanket claim all articles were heard.

PersonalPlaybackRunStart.description: Explicit playback start/resume establishes one run writer and immutable main. New run inherits only currently confirmed prefix of that same checkpoint/main. A new replay checkpoint starts at0. Do not merge distinct checkpoint/run portions. Later observations from another run cannot alter current UI/checkpoint or inherited prefix. Bind actual main playback only; followup/offer does not create main observation. No new completion is produced by copying an already-complete prefix.

PersonalLessonFinishRequest.description: Only explicit retry refusal for the current validated retry_offer and feedback/first anchor. Silence, STOP, failure or privacy interruption is not terminal. Do not create a retry or success. Validate active session/current epoch before any cached learning receipt; duplicate in current epoch is checked before version. Clear resume only if still this lesson, atomically. Explicit refusal also acknowledges the matching current feedback as an explicit user action; clear only that pending feedback atomically with terminal reason and conditional resume cleanup. Preserve the first validated content_success: sufficient content with language_form remains true; insufficient/incorrect remains false. retry_outcome stays null (not assessed), with no extra content success. A refusal can acknowledge its matching feedback but never an optional hidden/unplayed example.

PersonalLessonPresentationRequest.description: Acknowledge the matching pending feedback only after actual parked presentation, verified voice completion or explicit user response. Callback sent/GET result is not delivery. Unknown Gleo lifecycle cannot be synthesized. Version/matching pending guard prevents old ACK clearing newer feedback/resume. This acknowledges feedback only. The explicit array references independently recorded matching observed tickets; empty is allowed. Never infer complete-example exposure from all support_issued fields, hidden components, whole-page visibility or generic refusal.

PersonalAttemptRecord.description: Read-only accepted submission plus server-derived attempt_acceptance exposure assessment. Client answer payload stays immutable; exposure assessments have independent revisions. It is not accepted as AttemptInput. Authoritative status is derived by the server; AttemptInput cannot write it. Non-English/unverified stored diagnostic attempts never consume valid first/retry.

PersonalFormatChangeRequest.description: Explicit current-article one-time replay only. Flush source checkpoint first. Verify source belongs to this stream/profile/epoch and its checkpoint version, separately from stream head CAS. Resolve approved sibling only in the same pinned bundle/source snapshot; arbitrary target refs are not accepted. A request to the already selected mode conflicts. Atomically save new selection + main checkpoint at position0 + stream head + receipt. Do not inherit another mode/run prefix, mutate preferences, erase old work/completion, or change resume implicitly. Unavailable/withdrawn target leaves original work intact.

PersonalFormatChangeResponse.description: One persisted explicit_format_change selection and initial main checkpoint; source snapshot/article must be identical, target mode differs, main position0 and active_run_id null. Start the new run with frontier0 through the existing run API only after current output gates and explicit versioned resume selection. Stale response is storage, never a playback instruction.

PersonalPracticePresentationPrepare.description: Register exact approved/server-generated support components BEFORE potential display/voice. Server stores a prepared presentation, verifies owner/epoch/installation/task/question/artifacts and original context, and opens the same canonical exposure row if complete_example is included. Preparation is not exposure or received help. Without a durable registered grant, complete-example presentation waits for connection; previously registered grants remain uncertain until observed. New generic reads never authorize output. Select exact role/language refs from PracticeSupportManifest; no guessed ref names. question_meaning has kind=null but its observed ref/role is still stored; it is not a fact hint or complete-example exposure.

PersonalPracticePresentationRecord.description: Read-only durable ticket and observed status. Server retains original installation/context hash and causal lineage privately. Contains no live output grant on sync. Any unresolved full-example ticket makes negative exposure proof unknown; expiry is not no-delivery evidence.

PersonalPracticePresentationTicket.description: Persist ticket before rendering; current owner/window/safety/output grant must still be checked locally. Original context echo binds subsequent witnessed observations; it is never a current-output permission after navigation/restart.

PersonalPracticePresentationObservation.description: Immutable witnessed observation of this ticket, not a client exposure flag. Completed proves every listed artifact was actually provided through an environment-verified route, including exact example text; split tickets when only some components will appear. A generic feedback response/decline, CallbackSent, queue acceptance or guessed output end is not proof. not_presented_verified needs positively verified cancellation before ANY component output; a client flag/timeout/expiry alone cannot clean uncertainty. Validate current storage owner/epoch and original installation/context/artifact; a genuinely journaled same-epoch observation may arrive after navigation without changing lesson pending state/resume. Old-epoch callbacks never recreate deleted records.

PersonalPracticePresentationReceipt.description: Updates only delivery/exposure facts. Never consumes a valid answer, alters semantic content_success/terminal reason, clears another pending feedback or selects active_resume. Same payload retry returns its receipt only at the current authorized epoch; no state/version downgrade from an old receipt.

PersonalDialogueProgressObservation.description: Immutable actual HINT_METHOD completion fact. Existing same-owner/current-epoch lesson required; no upsert. OR only its dialogue business flag, independent of lesson phase/version; never change valid anchors/terminal/pending feedback/resume. Validate original output evidence and dedupe output instance. Old epoch/absent lesson rejected.

PersonalDialogueProgressEvent.description: Append-only witnessed business event through existing sync, not a stale LessonInput phase update. Same UUID/payload idempotent. Receipt references current lesson ID/version; delayed event can persist true after a phase advance without reverting that phase. New first offline sync can already restore true after the create/observation order is applied.

InferenceFeedbackGeneration.description: input_gate is a deterministic held-input response, with no model invocation and null model/prompt revisions; validator/rubric revisions remain actual configured values. fixture/live continue their original provenance meaning.

InferenceQAResponse.description: answered has at most three supported sentences and verified evidence for the frozen source. outside_listening_script identifies original-only information absent from the selected main script and requires that distinction in the answer. not_supported adds no invented fact.

InferenceFeedbackRequest.description: Save/confirm one immutable submission before evaluation. Server validates or conditionally creates the first submission only at current owner/epoch and an existing valid lesson. A late callback may only update an existing valid attempt. For retry, retrieve retry_of_attempt_id and prior focus from same-owner same-task stored feedback. First attempt has null retry_of_attempt_id. Recognition-unassessable does not consume valid turn. Lock lesson when accepting a new submission; at most one pending attempt, one valid first and one valid retry. Unassessable consumes neither. Effective current-lesson help unions only confirmed delivered support with validated request snapshots; generated support_issued is not delivery. Server derives canonical-question exposure separately under a shared exposure/lesson lock before model execution. Prepared/unresolved examples mean unknown; client cannot erase prior exposure or submit a clean-status claim. Before a new valid turn, synchronize acknowledgement of the previous matching presented feedback; pending presentation cannot be silently erased. Reject conflicting lesson/pending state. Validate origin-language evidence before model execution. Non-English/unverified uses deterministic input_gate/unassessable; never infer English from answer_text or silently consume a retry. A held retry has null retry_outcome.

InferenceFeedbackResponse.description: Single focus. Priority: fact error, missing content, confirmed language form. correction is allowed only for language_form with verified fidelity. Server renderer derives support_issued from output, including complete examples; it must not silently put an untracked full example into feedback_ko. Sufficient natural answers finish without an invented correction. Missing-fact feedback uses supplement mode and focus_fact_refs; language/fact correction uses rephrase mode. For recognition/unassessable, no lesson retry is spent and the question is suspended; do not invent a correction or completion. retry_outcome is null for first submissions and is evaluated from authenticated stored previous attempt/feedback for subsequent submissions. support_issued/prepared_supports record prepared output components, not delivered help or prior-example status. Renderer binds every full example to an exact immutable support artifact and question, including examples embedded in feedback. Actual delivery uses the presentation ticket/observation protocol; generic feedback ACK is separate. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

InferenceCorrection.description: Unicode code point offsets, end exclusive. Fragment must equal the submitted answer slice; replacement changes only one confirmed form.

InferenceAttemptResult.description: feedback is non-null only for succeeded. Same owner/epoch and original input capture are retained. Includes authoritative attempt_acceptance exposure assessment separately from StoredFeedback and current LessonState. New rounds preserve same-question exposure and may still have content_success=true after an example; exclude exposed/unknown from SC003 numerator without changing its denominator. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

InferenceStoredFeedback.description: Durable semantic feedback shared by personal history and inference GET; no transient presentation context or stale lesson snapshot. Read current LessonState separately. support_issued/prepared_supports record prepared output components, not delivered help or prior-example status. Renderer binds every full example to an exact immutable support artifact and question, including examples embedded in feedback. Actual delivery uses the presentation ticket/observation protocol; generic feedback ACK is separate. Server derives English status from evidence, never from normalized text alone. Non-English/unverified is held via unassessable; no valid anchor/English success and a held retry preserves prior first/content_success with retry_outcome null. Verified English with unknown form can content-judge without form correction.

ProgressProfileSessionContext.description: Expected profile only. Verified JWT plus active session/installation binding authorizes access. No learning-history epoch for daily preferences.

ProgressConfirmedDailyBoundary.description: Original next local calendar date start, resolved once to UTC using validated clock/zone evidence. Never plus24h or recomputed on restore.

ProgressUnresolvedDailyBoundary.description: No confirmed original calendar boundary. Suppress automatic expiry-based invitations, preserve any previously confirmed boundary and allow explicit release immediately. Do not use the later synchronization date as the original day.

ProgressDailyChoice.description: Explicit default is a release, not absence/expiry. It inherits the known original boundary. Replay is not a new explicit choice.

ProgressServerClockSample.description: Calendar clock anchor only: not proof of vehicle zone, user authorization, audio completion or original practice time.

ProgressDailyPreferenceView.description: Version0/null means never selected. Expired choices remain stored; expiry does not erase explicit decisions.

ProgressDailyPreferenceRequest.description: Independent CAS compares version and previous choice ID. Same immutable operation/key returns original receipt. No automatic rebase after conflict; no ordinary settings draft fields. Same current choice_id and decision means only unresolved-to-confirmed original-evidence resolution, with a new operation/key and current CAS; no confirmed-boundary rewrite. A different choice_id is a fresh explicit choice. Original local observation must be linked by the clock verifier; later current time is not original evidence.

ProgressDailyPreferenceReceipt.description: Receipt for this commit, not necessarily the latest global choice. Older receipt cannot replace newer local intent.

ProgressConfirmedPracticeTime.description: Validated original accepted-answer time; never receive/feedback/card/restore/lesson-end time.

ProgressPracticeTimeEvidence.description: Input claim. Validate original attempt-bound clock evidence; newly observed clock cannot justify arbitrary historical dates.

ProgressPracticeTimeRequest.description: URL attempt must already exist in this owner/epoch. Metadata is not another attempt/evaluation. Unknown can become confirmed only with validated original evidence; confirmed time is immutable.

ProgressRecordVisibility.description: Absent row means false/version0. Only explicit hide/unhide changes visibility; card derivation never writes it.

ProgressVisibilityRequest.description: Current owner/epoch and original lesson CAS. Hide filters locally immediately; unhide waits for server confirmation. No silent conflict overwrite.

ProgressExampleExposureSummary.description: Read-only causal assessment. Missing legacy evidence is unknown. GET/empty help arrays/own quote are not exposure evidence.

ProgressRecordAssistance.description: Actually received supports before representative answer. Lesson-start exposure and representative-acceptance exposure remain separate; later examples do not rewrite causal eligibility.

ProgressRepresentativeAnswer.description: Sufficient valid retry first; otherwise sufficient valid first. Validate actual anchors, English and form independently. Arrival time does not select representative.

ProgressLatestRecordResult.description: Latest actual result/remaining correction, separate from historical sufficient representative. Held/unsuccessful later replies never erase earlier sufficient evidence. Select the latest accepted attempt by internal per-lesson server acceptance sequence, including held attempts. Pending or legacy-unknown order remains unknown; response arrival and client practice time do not choose latest.

ProgressRecordSourceAccess.description: Current source/rights availability. Retained own utterance does not license unavailable article/support text or replacement of a pinned question.

ProgressSpeakingRecordSummary.description: Read-only one-card-per-lesson projection. No raw answer/full feedback/support text/new mastery score in list item. No model call or presentation ACK.

ProgressQuoteExcerpt.description: Validate start < end <= code-point length and exact contiguous representative substring. No rewritten/discontinuous quote.

ProgressRepresentativeQuote.description: Exact representative answer only with verified form and no uncertain spans. Never a correction/example.

ProgressSpeakingRecordDetail.description: Parked review only. Quote/summary are not feedback/support presentation. Original feedback fetch and matching actual presentation are separate explicit actions.

ProgressSpeakingRecordPage.description: Cursor binds owner/epoch/revision/filter. Default20/max50 is transport pagination, not history limit. Changed snapshot or stale epoch conflicts, not false empty page.

LegacyPlaybackRunRecord5.description: One verified session/installation writer, one immutable main asset. Server derives confirmed frontier. A new-device resume copies only the server-confirmed prefix at run start; later old tail never changes that initial snapshot. Other runs remain independent history. An inherited frontier already at duration never generates another completion merely by run creation; only a new actual qualifying extension creates a completion.

LegacyPlaybackObservationInput5.description: Append-only continuous actual playback interval [start,end). Validate 0<=start<end<=server asset duration and writer/session/owner/epoch. Close intervals at seek/stall/interruption; never bridge unplayed time. Apply only contiguous observation sequence. An observed range extends frontier only when start<=current frontier; never union a previously skipped tail retroactively. Unknown does not advance.

LegacyListeningCompletionRecord5.description: Server derived once per qualifying run; frontier==duration on one pinned main. Preserve real repeated runs; automatic exclusion is article_id exists across current-profile/epoch completions. Neither endpoint/EOS nor followup nor comprehension is proof.
